builds.name: Dragon's Rage ceiling
builds.summary: Dragon Rage primary hit has 625+2 AD[statFormula=2]. Secondary collision also adds 18% kicked victims bonus HP; fixed 1500 bonus-HP victim makes that 270 additional physical damage.
builds.goal: Dragon Rage primary hit has 625+2 AD[statFormula=2]. Secondary collision also adds 18% kicked victims bonus HP; fixed 1500 bonus-HP victim makes that 270 additional physical damage.
builds.hypothesis:
Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick Knocking Back an enemy champion and dealing [175 / 400 / 625 + (2) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Enemies the target collides with are briefly Knocked Up and take [175 / 400 / 625 + (2) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [12 / 15 / 18]% of the kicked enemy's bonus Health as physical damage.
Bloodthirster/Infinity Edge/Eclipse provide high AD; Grudge supplies armor penetration; Profane/Youmuu supply AD and lethality. Infinity Edge crit is not assumed to multiply this spell. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

builds.name: Resonating Strike: missing-health follow-up
builds.summary: Explore a high Resonating Strike second cast result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high Resonating Strike second cast result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 Q2 starts at 180 + 0.9 bonus AD and can scale to twice that amount with target missing health. Item AD and physical penetration target the follow-up. Q1 and any R used to lower health are setup damage and cannot be included again in the Q2-only result. Read the exact missing-health multiplier at the chosen HP.

Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit, granting True Sight of them, and allows Lee Sin to Recast for the next [3] seconds.

builds.name: Tempest: total-AD magic burst
builds.summary: Investigate high one Tempest magic impact output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Tempest magic impact output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
